queries_run: Hyatt Hotels largest customer second-source OR in-house 2026

findings.claim: Hyatt 10-K FY2025 states no single customer is material to its business; customers are diversified corporate, association, specialty, travel agency and individual consumer accounts.
findings.excerpt: No single customer is material to our business.

customer_second_source.note: 酒店業態無單一最大客戶供應鏈關係；搜尋亦無第二供應商／自製相關來源。
